Dear Client,

I'm following up on your login loop issue reported on April 21st. I've reviewed the ticket and wanted to let you know that we're actively investigating this matter.

To help us resolve this issue more efficiently, could you please provide:
1. Any error messages or screenshots you're seeing
2. The browser/device you're using
3. Steps to reproduce the issue
4. Whether this is affecting multiple users or just one account

We'll work to identify the root cause and provide a resolution as soon as possible. I'll keep you updated on our progress.

Best regards,
Support Team
